description: Full ODE drill set: verifying a proposed solution against a given equation, converting Leibniz-notation derivative equations to explicit y'=f(x), separable variables (Part II drills), first-order linear homogeneous y'+ay=0 (general solution + IVP), first-order linear nonhomogeneous y'+ay=g(x) (general + IVP + particular-solution-guessing), second-order homogeneous constant-coefficient y''+by'+cy=0 by characteristic-root case (real distinct / repeated / complex), second-order with IVP, verifying a specific function is a solution, and second-order nonhomogeneous via undetermined coefficients (polynomial/exponential RHS).

source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 math exercise compendium (Start Up Community), Lesson 10: សមីការឌីផេរ៉ង់ស្យែល (Differential Equations) — exercises only, no worked solutions
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from scanned textbook (Claude Code), 2026-08-29

exercises.technique: Verify a given closed-form f(x) satisfies the stated ODE by direct substitution
Find the general/particular antiderivative given dy/dx expressed in Leibniz notation, including separable-variable rewriting
Solve separable ODEs with an initial condition to determine the constant
first_order_linear_homogeneous: y'+ay=0 \Rightarrow y=Ce^{-ax} (last two items reduce to this form after factoring)
first_order_linear_nonhomogeneous: y'+ay=g(x), solve via homogeneous + particular solution (undetermined coefficients matching g(x)'s form: constant, polynomial, exponential, or trig)
second_order_homogeneous_constant_coeff with two distinct real characteristic roots r_1,r_2: y=C_1e^{r_1x}+C_2e^{r_2x}
second_order_homogeneous_constant_coeff with a repeated (double) characteristic root r: y=(C_1+C_2x)e^{rx}
second_order_homogeneous_constant_coeff with complex-conjugate characteristic roots \alpha\pm i\beta: y=e^{\alpha x}(C_1\cos\beta x+C_2\sin\beta x)
second_order_homogeneous with two initial conditions y(x_0), y'(x_0) to solve for both constants C_1,C_2
second_order_nonhomogeneous_undetermined_coefficients with constant/polynomial, trig, or exponential right-hand side

exercises.prompt_latex: -y'+2y=0,\ y(3)=-2;\ 3y'+6y=0,\ \text{curve through}(-4,2);\ y''-2y'-3y=0,\ y(0)=-1,y'(1)=1/e;\ 4y''-4y'+y=0,\ y(0)=-3,y'(0)=2;\ y''+4y'+8y=0,\ y(0)=1,y'(0)=2;\ (E):y''+5y'+6y=0,\ \text{find particular solution with tangent}\ D:y=x-1\ \text{at}\ x=0;\ (E):2y''-3y'+y=0,\ \text{find particular solution }g\ \text{tangent to}\ d:y=-\tfrac12x\ \text{at}\ O(0,0);\ (E):y''+2y'+2y=0,\ \text{find particular solution tangent to}\ L:y=2x+1\ \text{at}\ A(0,1);\ (E):y''-y'+\tfrac14y=0,\ \text{find particular solution whose graph passes through}\ M(0,4)\ \text{and has a horizontal tangent at}\ x=2;\ (E):y''+9y=0,\ \text{find particular solution }g\ \text{tangent to}\ (d):y+1=x-\pi\ \text{at}\ M(\pi,-1);\ (E):y''-3y'+2y=0,\ \text{find the solution with a maximum of value}\ 1\ \text{at}\ x=1;\ (E):y''+6y'+13y=0,\ \text{find the solution }f\ \text{with an inflection value equal to}\ 1\ \text{at}\ x=0;\ (E):y''-6y=y',\ \text{show}\ y=e^{-2x}-e^{3x}\ \text{is a particular solution};\ (E):y'+2y=y'',\ \text{show}\ y=3e^{2x}-2e^{-x}\ \text{is a particular solution};\ (E):y''-2y'=2y'-4y,\ \text{show}\ y=(2x-1)e^{2x}\ \text{is a particular solution};\ y''+3y'+y=y'-y\ (E),\ \text{show}\ y=(7\cos x-4\sin x)e^{-x}\ \text{is a particular solution}
exercises.technique: Word-style problems specifying an IVP via a geometric condition (point on curve, tangent line, extremum, inflection value) instead of raw y(x_0)/y'(x_0), plus verify-a-guessed-particular-solution items

exercises.prompt_latex: (E):y''-4y'+2y=4,\ \text{find constant }k\ \text{particular solution, solve general, find particular with}\ y(0)=2\sqrt2,y'(0)=0;\ (E):y''+4y'+4y=-4x,\ \text{find particular solution, solve}\ (E)\ \text{with}\ y(0)=2,y'(0)=-2;\ (E):y'-3y=3x^2+4x+1,\ \text{find}\ y_c\ \text{of}\ y'-3y=0,\ \text{find}\ a,b,c\ \text{s.t.}\ y_p=ax^2+bx+c,\ \text{find general}\ y;\ (E_1):-y''-y'+6y=6x^2-2x+4,\ \text{solve}\ (E_2):-y''-y'+6y=0,\ \text{find polynomial}\ P(x)=ax^2+bx+c\ \text{particular solution, general solution of}\ (E_1)$;\ (E):y'+2y=2e^{-x}/(1+2e^x);\ \text{solve}\ (x^2-1)dy=2x\,dx,\ e^{x^2}dy-2x\,dx=0,\ dy/dx=e^{x+y},\ dy/dx=(y^2-1)/x,\ dy/dx=(x-2)/(x-4),\ dy/dx=e^{x-y}+x^2e^{-y};\ \text{solve}\ y'+2y=x^2,\ y'-4y=xe^{4x},\ y'+3y=(3x^2+6x+2)e^{-3x},\ y'-2y=3\cos2x,\ y'-3y=7\sin3x-6\cos3x,\ y''-4y'-12y=-5e^{-2x},\ y''-2y'+y=4\cos2x+3\sin2x,\ y''-5y'+6y=(2x^2+3)e^{4x},\ y''-5y'+4y=(6x+1)e^x,\ y''-4y'+4y=(2x+1)e^{2x};\ y''-6y'+8y=0\ (\alpha),\ \text{find}\ g\ \text{solution of}\ (\alpha)\ \text{whose graph}\ G\ \text{passes through}\ E(0,-1);\ 2y''-3y'+y=0\ (E),\ \text{find}\ g(x)\ \text{tangent to}\ d:y=-\tfrac12x\ \text{at}\ O(0,0)\ (\text{BAC 2013});\ 9y''+y=0\ (E),\ \text{find}\ g\ \text{s.t.}\ \int_0^{\pi/2}g(x)dx=0\ \text{and}\ \int_0^\pi g(x)dx=3\ (\text{BAC 2010})
exercises.technique: Hard section: general+particular solution IVPs, symbolic-coefficient undetermined-coefficient setups for a family of nonhomogeneous RHS types, verify-guessed-general-solution, and BAC-exam problems requiring an integral condition instead of a point condition

exercises.prompt_latex: f(x)=e^{-2x}\ln(1+2e^x)\ \text{solution of}\ (E):y'+2y=2e^{-x}/(1+2e^x);\ \text{find}\ \varphi\ \text{solution of}\ (E)\ \text{s.t.}\ (\varphi-f)\ \text{solves}\ (E'):y'+2y=0\ (\text{BacII 2015});\ (E):y''+3y'=5,\ \text{find particular}\ g(x)=Ax,\ \text{solve}\ y''+3y'=5,\ \text{find solution with}\ y(0)=e^3,y'(1)=2/3;\ (E):-y''+2y'+4y=-2\cos2x,\ \text{solve}\ (E'):-y''+2y'+4y=0,\ \text{find}\ a,b\ \text{s.t.}\ g(x)=a\cos2x+b\sin2x\ \text{particular},\ \text{show}\ h=f+g\ \text{solves}\ (E)\ \text{if}\ f\ \text{solves}\ (E'),\ \text{find}\ h\ \text{with}\ h(0)=0,h'(0)=0;\ (E):y''+4y=x^2+2x-1,\ \text{solve}\ (E_1):y''+4y=0,\ \text{find}\ f_1(x)=ax^2+bx+c\ \text{particular},\ \text{show}\ g=f-f_1\ \text{solves}\ (E_1)\ \text{if}\ f\ \text{solves}\ (E),\ \text{find general}\ f;\ (E):y''-3y'+2y=2x^2-5x+3,\ \text{find quadratic particular}\ P(x),\ \text{show}\ f\ \text{solves}\ (E)\ \text{iff}\ h=f-P\ \text{solves}\ (E'):y''-3y'+2y=0,\ \text{solve}\ (E')\ \text{and deduce general}\ f\ \text{of}\ (E),\ \text{find}\ f\ \text{with a described tangent-line-slope initial condition}
exercises.technique: Multi-part word problems: split a nonhomogeneous ODE into complementary+particular via an auxiliary function g or h introduced by the problem, then solve for constants from geometric/IVP conditions

exercises.prompt_latex: (E):y''+9y=2\cos x,\ \text{given}\ y=Z+k\cos x,\ Z\ \text{function of}\ x,\ k\ \text{constant}:\ \text{find}\ k\ \text{s.t.}\ Z\ \text{solves}\ Z'+9Z=0\ \text{when}\ y=Z+k\cos x\ \text{solves}\ (E),\ \text{solve}\ Z''+9Z=0\ \text{and deduce general solution of}\ (E),\ \text{find the solution with}\ y(0)=0,y'(\pi)=3;\ (E):y''+y=\sin x,\ \text{find}\ \alpha\ \text{s.t.}\ \varphi(x)=\alpha x\cos x\ \text{solves}\ (E),\ \text{let}\ f\ \text{solve}\ (E),\ \text{show}\ (f-\varphi)''+(f-\varphi)=0,\ \text{solve}\ y''+y=0\ \text{and deduce general}\ f\ \text{of}\ (E);\ f''+2f'=0,\ \text{let}\ g=f',\ \text{show}\ g\ \text{solves}\ g'+2g=0,\ \text{solve}\ g'+2g=0,\ \text{deduce general solution of}\ f''+2f'=0\ \text{by a second integration}
exercises.technique: Reduction-of-order technique: introduce a substitution (y=Z+k\cos x, or g=f') that turns a harder ODE into a first-order one already covered, solve that, then integrate/recombine for the original equation's general solution

exercises.technique: Semester-2 review bank (section III): curated real BAC II exam ODE problems (2016-2023) plus review IVPs combining verify-general-solution, geometric tangent conditions, and split-into-particular-plus-homogeneous techniques
